strategy: Read-before-write exact stable-key create plan plus one audited identity fork; this package records executable payloads only and performs no mutation.

casBaselineGate.verification: Re-read all scoped tables, hash the canonical readback, and compare every table count before any create/update call.

identityPolicy.stableKeyLinkResolution: Resolve all stableLink tokens against the CAS readback first; existing IDs come only from that readback, new IDs come only from successful Airtable create responses.

legacyInitialIdentityFork.cas: require the exact live recordId/current masterKey before the update; re-read exact after fields before continuing

rollbackRestore.order: restore this identity fork before any created-ID rollback

sourceRecord.reason: Live source identity and descriptive fields already match the v3 synthetic boundary; do not remap the source primary key.

releaseDraftRecord.reason: Reuse the single existing Release Draft row while changing only release metadata to the v3 approved synthetic release.

beforeFields.releaseNotes: Dog/cat synthetic operational flow pilot; not for clinical use.

beforeWritableFields.releaseNotes: Dog/cat synthetic operational flow pilot; not for clinical use.

afterFields.releaseNotes: Synthetic operational master v3; explicitly non-authoritative.
afterFields.reviewReason: Deterministic structural and operational-flow fixture; not clinical approval.

fields.releaseNotes: Dog/cat synthetic operational flow pilot; not for clinical use.

rollbackRestore.reason: If the Release Draft update succeeds and a later create/verify step fails, restore the exact pre-update writable fields before reverting any created records.

semanticDiffAgainstLiveReadback.normalizationRule: Airtable omits null-valued cells; omitted cells are equivalent to authoring null and are not written back.
semanticDiffAgainstLiveReadback.stableKeyAndRecordIdPreservation: 106 current master rows remain byte/semantically unchanged; one audited legacy identity fork preserves the Master/Name record IDs while changing only the Master Records.masterKey from the legacy key to the fresh v3 key; 147 additive master/name rows and additive relation/path rows are planned.

auditedIdentityFork.cas: require the exact live recordId/current masterKey before the update; re-read exact after fields before continuing

rollbackRestore.order: restore this identity fork before any created-ID rollback

dependencyOrder: CAS-and-semantic-readback identity fork for the legacy initial Airtable row
Lab Panel Items create by panelMasterKey+testMasterKey
Lab Order Profiles create by orderMasterKey
Diagnosis Category Links verify by diagnosisMasterKey+categoryMasterKey
Release Drafts update existing recordId after all creates and the identity fork verify
rollbackOrder: Restore Release Drafts by current recordId using releaseDraft.rollbackRestore.fields
Restore the audited legacy initial Master Records identity fork by recordId
Rollback created Lab Order Profiles by createdRecordId
Rollback created Lab Panel Items by createdRecordId
Rollback created Classification Paths by createdRecordId
Rollback created Master Records by createdRecordId
